name: El Tornadizo (Spain)
description: Red field with a white triangle with its base along the fly and its apex at the hoist, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of El Tornadizo (a tree on red within a bordure of chain).
history: Municipal flag of El Tornadizo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
